msg: 开始调研「AI 会议纪要」的 5 个产品…
Fathom：读取 38 个页面，记录 6843 字
Otter.ai：读取 30 个页面，记录 5210 字
Granola：读取 43 个页面，记录 7814 字
Fireflies.ai：读取 45 个页面，记录 8245 字
tl;dv：读取 39 个页面，记录 5060 字

positioning.value: Otter.ai is an AI notetaker and conversational knowledge engine that transcribes meetings and turns them into searchable knowledge to power workflows, supporting Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and more.

target_user.value: Otter.ai targets individuals, professionals, small teams, and larger teams/enterprises, with plans ranging from free for individuals and small teams to Business and Enterprise for larger organizations.

core_capability.value: Otter.ai provides live multi-language transcription with speaker recognition, automated meeting summaries with decisions, action items, and insights, AI Chat across meetings and connected apps, CRM sales insights, and conversation organization via Channels.

free_tier.value: The free tier includes 300 monthly transcription minutes, 30 minutes per conversation, and 3 lifetime imported audio/video files per user.

start_price.value: The lowest paid plan (Pro) is $16.99 per user per month on monthly billing or $8.33 per user per month on annual billing.

price_model.value: Otter.ai uses a per-user/seat-based subscription model with tiered plans: Basic (free), Pro, Business, and Enterprise.

key_limit.value: Key limits include 300 transcription minutes per user per month on the free plan, 30 minutes max per conversation, 3 lifetime pre-recorded audio/video file imports, 25 most recent conversation history, 20 monthly Otter AI Chat queries per user on the free tier (3 per conversation), and SSO requiring a 100-user license.

deployment.value: Otter.ai is available as a SaaS/web app, iOS and Android mobile apps, Mac/Windows desktop app, and Chrome capture; no on-premises deployment was stated.

data_policy.value: Otter trains proprietary models on de-identified, encrypted user data with an automatic process and no manual human review; the privacy policy confirms no opt-out for this training.

positioning.value: The AI notepad for people in back-to-back meetings; notes, actions and memory handled for you, quietly.

target_user.value: Over half of Granola users are in leadership roles; founders and leaders at companies like Vercel, Ramp, and Roblox, and partners at top VC firms like Benchmark, Sequoia, Accel, and Union Square Ventures use it.

core_capability.value: Granola captures audio directly from your device, transcribes in real time and deletes audio immediately, with no recordings stored; you capture rough notes during the conversation, then AI enhances them afterward, with your notes in black and AI additions in gray.

free_tier.value: Granola offers a free Basic plan at $0 per user per month, including AI meeting notes, limited meeting history, AI chat within and across meetings, shared folders for collaboration, customized note templates, multi-language support, and the ability to opt out of model training any time.

start_price.value: Granola's lowest paid plan is Business at $14 per user per month.

price_model.value: Granola charges per seat, not per meeting or storage gigabyte; you pay a flat monthly fee for each active user in your workspace, and your bill adjusts automatically when team members join or leave.

key_limit.value: You have to manually start Granola for a meeting; it won't auto-join or auto-record anything.

deployment.value: Granola is available for macOS 13+, Windows 10+, and iOS; download for macOS, Windows, or from the App Store for iOS.

data_policy.value: Granola does not allow third parties like OpenAI or Anthropic to use your data to train their AI models; it trains on your anonymized data to improve the product, you can opt out in Settings, and enterprise users have model training turned off by default.

positioning.value: Fathom 是一款会议助手，可录制、转录并总结 Zoom、Google Meet 或 Microsoft Teams 会议，让用户专注于对话而不是记笔记。

target_user.value: 面向个人用户和团队；免费席位适合不常做笔记、需要查看团队通话的经理，以及希望查看通话并提取客户洞察的产品团队。

core_capability.value: 可录制、转录并总结 Zoom、Google Meet 或 Microsoft Teams 会议，自动生成通话总结，更新 Salesforce 和 HubSpot，支持共享高亮片段和跨通话搜索。

free_tier.value: 免费版包含无限录制和存储、38 种语言的无限转录，每月前 5 次通话可使用高级总结；CRM 同步最多支持同一邮箱域下 3 个用户，免费版为标准体验且无可定制项。

start_price.value: 第三方资料显示，付费版按年付最低约每用户每月 15–16 美元（Premium $16/用户/月，Team $15/用户/月），但官方未公开最低付费档。

price_model.value: 按席位计价，年付价格低于月付（月付高 20–35%）；Team 和 Business 均有 2 席位最低要求。

key_limit.value: 免费版每月仅前 5 次通话可生成高级 AI 总结，之后只能使用 General/Enhanced 模板；CRM 同步（HubSpot、Salesforce、Close）最多支持同一邮箱域下 3 个用户。

deployment.value: 提供 Google Meet Chrome 扩展和 Fathom 桌面应用，以浏览器插件/桌面应用方式部署。

data_policy.value: 不会向第三方出售数据；AI 子处理器（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google）不得使用用户数据训练模型；Fathom 会使用去标识化客户数据改进自有模型，用户可在设置中或组织设置中选择退出。

positioning.value: Fireflies.ai helps your team transcribe, summarize, search, and analyze voice conversations.

target_user.value: Sales reps, customer success teams, recruiters, product managers and executives.

core_capability.value: Automatically records and transcribes meetings; AI search; 5-minute review of 1-hour meetings; view action items, tasks, questions; create soundbites; use AskFred; send notes to Slack, Notion, Asana; Conversation Intelligence (talk time, sentiment, monologues, objections/competitors).

free_tier.value: Free plan includes 3 free meeting transcriptions by default, unlimited transcription and AI summaries with Auto Join, 400 minutes storage per seat, 20 one-time AI credits per seat, 2-hour max recording per meeting, uploads up to 100MB/150min, and 3 public channels.

start_price.value: Pro: $10/mo/user billed annually or $18/mo/user billed monthly.

price_model.value: Prices per seat, billed annually; monthly billing available on Pro and Business.

downgraded.reason: 换算来源与起步价来源不同（guide.fireflies.ai ≠ guide.fireflies.ai），可能不是同一口径，不予采信

key_limit.value: Free plan: 400 minutes storage per seat, 20 one-time AI credits per seat, 2-hour max meeting recording, uploads up to 100MB/150min, 3 public channels.

deployment.value: Available via web browser, mobile app, Chrome extension, and desktop app; records meetings from Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex.

data_policy.value: Fireflies does not use meeting content or personal data to train AI models; zero data retention policy with third-party vendors; users retain full ownership and control of their data.

positioning.value: tl;dv is an AI meeting intelligence platform that turns every conversation into automated CRM updates, follow-ups, briefings, and pattern insights.

target_user.value: 用户包括销售团队、客户成功部门、咨询公司，以及任何将会议洞察视为重要资产的团队。

core_capability.value: tl;dv captures meetings on Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and in-person; transcribes over 100 languages at >95% accuracy; auto-updates CRM, drafts follow-ups, runs custom templates (MEDDIC, SPIN, SPICE), and answers questions across all past conversations with 5,000+ integrations.

free_tier.value: 免费计划永久免费，提供无限录制、40+语言无限转录，每月10次AI会议笔记，无需信用卡。

start_price.value: Free; Pro at $29/mo monthly ($18/mo billed annually, $216/yr); Business at $39/mo monthly ($29/mo billed annually, $348/yr); Enterprise (custom).

price_model.value: Pro/Business按席位收费，Enterprise为定制报价并可选按用量计价。

key_limit.value: 免费版每月仅10次AI会议笔记和10次AI查询，付费计划无使用上限。

deployment.value: 企业版可提供私有化AI托管选项。

data_policy.value: 会议数据在欧盟存储，使用AWS法兰克福和Google Cloud基础设施，绝不用客户数据训练AI模型。
